notes.title: MacOS version signed and notarized
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Minor subtitle fixes
[*]MacOS app signed and notarized. It should now be trusted by MacOS up to and including Catalina.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fix issue where game would get stuck at a black screen after the book intro on Windows 7
[*]Fix issue where one of the videos in the intro book wouldn't play on Linux
[*]Other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Release
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Add Colorblindness Assistance to the weight puzzle in Heine's room.
[*]Add 32-bit windows version.
[*]Added hint to the maze somewhere in the house.
[*]Bathroom puzzle eyeballs now properly rotate throughout gameplay making them easier to see.
[*]Adjusted dollar bill image for puzzle so it is easier to tell the difference between almost solved and solved. The two hairline pieces were too similar.
[*]Stopped machine from disappearing in the Room at the Top.
[*]Avid witness achievement properly unlocks after viewing the 5 normal endings.
[*]Fixed/Added sounds/music to various scenes.
[*]Fix issue where music would not honor volume settings on entering a room, credits, main menu, or choose character scene.
[*]Credit fixes.
[*]Attempt to fix cursor control/visibility issues some people have reported.
[*]Various lighting. texture, and subtitle fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fix collectible coins:[list]
[*]Some coins could not be collected due to other objects in the way.
[*]One coin was only collectible by Tad and was only available in a room he cannot enter.
[*]Fix achievement detection to look for the correct number of coins.[/list]
[/list]
This should resolve the last of the achievement issues.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4/1.0.5 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fix issue where cemetery puzzle would reset late in Tad's story. The cemetery scene can still be reopened by loading the game, but the puzzle will remain solved.
[*]Fix issue where one of the collectible coins was not collectible.
[*]Make library puzzle required for completing Dr. Richmond's story. 
[*]Fix various object interaction issues.
[*]Improve stability of money puzzle. It should be less likely to get stuck now.
[*]Fix '5' spot in spider puzzle.
[*]Minor video, visual, cursor, and subtitle fixes.
[*]Fix Cartographer achievement (for real this time)
[/list]

1.0.5 Puts the fridge door back in place. The spider was hungrier than we thought. Windows is live now, Mac and Linux will be patched to 1.0.5 within an hour.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Resolve issues unlocking achievements:[list]
[*]Fix detecting ending achievements
[*]Fix detecting Cartographer achievement
[*]Related achievements that were not unlocked due to these issues will be unlocked on 
startup[/list]
[*]Puzzle reset fixes:[list]
[*]Coin puzzle in Burden's room now resets properly
[*]Lab puzzle can now be reset[/list]
[*]Fix issues with puzzle hint menu wouldn't allow the puzzle to be skipped
[*]Fixed view of lab puzzle
[*]Modified spider puzzle for a bit more clarity
[*]Attempt to resolve issues with money puzzle not lining up properly
[*]Add ability to increase cursor size through the options menu
[*]Various minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed many of the crashes that can occur on Windows 7
[b]Note[/b]: this does not fix when the game remains running but stuck on a black screen. That requires the WebM video codecs installed and graphics drivers and windows up to date.
[*]Auto save now only affects "Continue" functionality, not save slots
[*]Fixed missing visuals in the choice scenes near the end of the game
[*]Various minor fixes
[/list]
